bottleneck.description: Top-5 Chinese industrial robot brand; concentration in PV/3C/auto integration with cross-shop substitutes.

dependency.key_customers: Chinese solar cell makers (55% of robot revenue), 3C electronics, auto Tier-1 customers; overseas OEMs (Stellantis, GM, VW, Toyota for niche projects)
dependency.key_suppliers: Italian acquisitions (CMA paint robots, EVOLUT integrator, ROBOX motion-control)

editorial.notes: EFORT is a designated Chinese 'little giant' in robotics but is a smaller share than Estun/Inovance/Siasun domestically and competes head-on with Big-4 in China and globally. Robot procurement is substitutable across vendors within a project cycle. No bottleneck position.
